brief:
Middle East Eye reported that former US President Donald Trump hinted the United States might review its position on the Falkland Islands' sovereignty, following remarks by Netanyahu's son backing Argentine claims over the territory. The statement came as Britain has intensified criticism of Israeli policy in Gaza and the occupied West Bank.

The timing reflects broader diplomatic tensions between London and Tel Aviv over the Gaza conflict. Netanyahu's son's support for Argentina's sovereignty claim on the disputed South Atlantic islands marked an unusual intervention by an Israeli figure into the long-standing territorial dispute.

title: Trump hints US may reconsider Falklands sovereignty stance
